recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-16052 unless a future issue reopens broader canonical URL wording concerns.
issue_request: FHIR-16052 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the Resource References / canonical URL page. It requested fixing a missing verb in the sentence about a canonical URI locating the master copy of an artifact, with the accepted resolution text "resolve to".
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn revision 14242. In the git import, commit 9e282851c89a1af94718b3178ccc818f53d7f5a2 (GF#16052 - fix typo) changed source/references.html from "The canonical URI SHOULD also be the location" to "The canonical URI SHOULD also resolve to the location".
additional_context: Later canonical URL documentation refactors moved the detailed canonical resource identity wording from references.html into source/resource/resource-notes.xml while source/references.html#canonical now links to Resource canonical identity for further information. Exact FHIR-16052 Zulip and Confluence searches found no issue-specific discussion or conflicting decision; a broader Zulip thread quoted the corrected wording while discussing a separate absolute canonical URL question.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active Resource source says "The canonical URL SHOULD also resolve to the location where the master copy of the artifact is found", and searches found no remaining "SHOULD also represent" or "SHOULD also be the location" wording in current source.
